item.title: Potential for heavy smoke continues for western and central Colorado, with some improvement for the eastern plains
item.description:
Air quality remains a concern across large parts of Colorado. It's a complex scenario so let's move from west to east across the state.

Western and central Colorado are seeing a wide variety of air quality conditions Wednesday morning. There is somewhat heavy smoke in parts of the San Juan Mountains in southwestern Colorado. This is especially true in some of the higher terrain to the west and southwest of Telluride and Silverton. Lower smoke levels can be found further north in Grand Junction, Aspen and Steamboat Springs. However, the Air Quality Health Advisory for Wildfire Smoke will be extended for the entire Western Slope until at least 9am Thursday.

First, wildfires to the west and northwest of Colorado remain very active.
